# 社會綜合 / Integrated Social Studies: course outline

**Version 1, 2026-11-28.** 1 part, 3 chapters, about 3 hours of lessons.  
Core: 0 parts, 0 chapters. Tracks: sprint-116.  
Papers: social. Paths: 社會 (`social`). Status: planned.

## Decisions

- 116 sprint first (owner, 2026-11-15): review chapters for students who studied the required subject in school; the full zero-to-hero core follows for 117.
- Owner (2026-11-28): a separate 社會綜合 course holds the shared part (two cross-subject chapters and an original 110-minute 社會 practice paper), as inquiry holds the 自然 mock.
- 合科 items were about 56% of items in 114 and about 40% of the score in 115 (CEEC 試題特色, research), so cross-subject reading gets its own chapters.
- Practice papers are original and only modelled on the 111–115 layout (papers.json); official papers are linked, never copied.

## Open questions

1. Subject accent colour for 社會綜合 (subjects.css): a new colour is a look change; to be proposed to the owner before these chapters are built.
2. Mock layout: 111–115 differ (Part 1 38–46 單選; Part 2 8–11 混合題組 with 10–11 written items; 144 points customary, not fixed by rule). The mock follows the 115 layout unless the owner prefers another year.

### Part 0: 社會跨科與模擬卷 / Across 社會, and a practice paper (track sprint-116)

**Question:** 一題看起來像歷史，考的卻可能是公民：怎麼看出每一小題真正考的是哪一科？ / An item that looks like history may test civics: how do you see which subject each part really tests?  
**Track:** 116 學測衝刺 / GSAT 116 sprint. Starts after (anywhere): 給已在學校讀過必修歷史、地理與公民、準備考 116 學測的同學：重點複習，不是從零開始。完整的從零課程將在 117 學年度課程中推出。 / For students who studied required history, geography and civics in school and sit the 116 GSAT: a focused review, not zero-to-hero. The full lessons arrive in the 117 course.  

*Why here:* After all three subjects (prereqs: their exam-skills chapters), as the inquiry part follows the four sciences.
